paths.title: AI for Content Creators
paths.tagline: Never run out of ideas, write in your own voice, repurpose one piece into ten, and build a content system that actually holds up.
paths.description: A 6-lesson path for content creators covering the AI workflows that make consistent output possible: systematic ideation grounded in your niche and real audience questions, scripting and outlining in your own voice, repurposing one long-form piece into ten platform-native posts, designing thumbnails and visuals with AI image tools, storyboarding short-form video concepts with AI video tools, and building a personal content operating system for calendar, batching, and consistency. Every lesson is built around a core habit: keep the AI grounded in your real voice, real audience signals, and real facts, instead of letting it default to generic output.

paths.title: AI for Social Media Managers
paths.tagline: Turn a strategy document into a month of posts, write platform-native captions, reply in brand voice, and report what happened and why.
paths.description: A 6-lesson path for social media managers covering the AI workflows that save the most time on the job: turning a strategy document into a full month of pillar-tagged posts, writing platform-native captions and hooks, drafting engagement replies in brand voice with clear escalation rules, turning raw analytics into a narrative report that separates facts from hypotheses, generating consistent on-brand campaign visuals with AI image tools, and running multi-client workflows with separate voice profiles, templates, and approval flows. Every lesson is built around a core habit: keep the AI grounded in the strategy, voice, and data you actually supply, and have it flag gaps instead of guessing.
